docs:
Chips — A selection list of 3D chips that press into the surface.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Poppins (600, 700 and 800). If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.
